Super!
Aug 2026 • Couples
I really liked MITAMI! A small, cozy, and very atmospheric Japanese restaurant. Despite the full seating, everything is organized clearly: queue by appointment, waited not long at all.

We were seated at the sushi bar right in front of the chefs, and it turned out to be even more interesting than a regular table. You can watch sushi masters prepare sushi, sashimi, and other dishes—everything right in front of you. Therefore, if there are one or two of you, I highly recommend asking for a spot right at the bar.

I would like to specifically mention the products - very fresh fish and seafood, everything is really delicious. You can feel a real Japanese atmosphere: a small room, an open kitchen, no unnecessary details—very cozy and authentic.

One of those restaurants you want to go back to. I definitely recommend it to lovers of Japanese cuisine and fresh seafood!

Rolls that captured the heart
May 2025 • Couples
My wife loves Philadelphia, and I'm quite relaxed about Japanese cuisine. But at Mitami, it's like I rediscovered it. We've never tasted sushi and rolls like this anywhere. The rice melts in the mouth and leaves the most rich taste of fish and seafood. I confess I never imagined sushi could taste so good.

I recommend taking a set from Sushi and separately try Hokkigai (spisula).
Also Philadelphia must taste, baked oysters and seafood roll.

Prices are as adequate as possible, in the evening we took a set of sushi, three rolls, mini soup, fried vegetables, oysters under cheese, 4 beers and all this came to about 1,500,000 dong (~6,000₽)
